en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Yahya Bin Masour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘
Al-Suweyq and the broth of the meat of the cow (beef soup), both do away with (remove)  the vitiligo’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘ from Yahya ibn Musawir who has said the following: “Abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
sawiq and broth of cow meat remove al-Bars (Albinism) illness.’”
